messages:
Maya: Thanks for joining the post-allhands thread. Dropping the RCA link and a compact action table. Please ack and add ETAs + customer-impact notes in the ops tracker: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-27 
Sam: Acknowledged. I'll take the adaptive batching recommendation and run a perf sweep. ETA: Tue midday. Will note customer impact as 'reduced token latency for high QPS customers'.
Priya: I'll own alert throttling and noisy-rule pruning. Can we set up a 30m with SRE tomorrow morning? @Noah what times work for you?
Noah: 10:00 PST works for me. Also volunteering to drive the model-fallback policy implementation. Quick question: do we store fallback metrics separately or tag them?
Maya: Tag them initially (fallback=true) for easy rollups; we can split to separate metrics later if we need dashboards per-fallback-type. Documented in the RCA notes under Telemetry.
Ava: FYI I ran a small LRU tweak on staging overnight. p95 memory dropped 9% but p99 is still noisy. I'll schedule a heap-profiling run and post flamegraphs.
Sam: Good call. I'll coordinate batching changes with Ava so we don't mask memory signals.
Priya: IncidentBot  can you create tracker items for the following: alert tuning, batching sweep, fallback policy, telemetry tagging, profiling?
IncidentBot: Created actions: INC-2026-27-A10 (Priya) alert tuning, INC-2026-27-A11 (Sam) adaptive batching sweep, INC-2026-27-A12 (Noah) fallback policy impl, INC-2026-27-A13 (Maya) telemetry tagging, INC-2026-27-A14 (Ava) heap profiling. All 2-week SLA. Ops link: https://redwood.internal/ops/INC-2026-27/actions 
Noah: I'll pair with Sam on rollout plan to ensure canary percentage ramps are safe. Putting a draft in the PR by EOD.
Maya: Leadership ask: include estimated customer-visible downtime or error-rate delta for each action (even if zero). Helps prioritize.
Sam: Will add those estimates after the perf sweep completes.
Priya: Added 10:00 PST SRE sync to calendar. 
Ava: I'll post flamegraphs to the thread once the profiling job finishes (~3 hrs).
Maya: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've added ETA + customer impact in the ops tracker. Quick 15m sync Friday to close blockers.
Sam: ✅ added.
Priya: ✅ added.
Noah: ✅ added.
Ava: ✅ will add after profiling runs.
Maya: Thanks folks. If you hit a blocker, ping me or drop into #eng-oncall. Closing thread but will reopen if new actions created.
